title: URL slug generator
description: Turn arbitrary text into a URL-safe slug that is never undefined, never contains characters that need escaping in a path, and never has leading, trailing or repeated separators.

clauses.text: Ordinary text becomes a lowercase, hyphen-separated slug.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "handles ordinary input" passes

clauses.text: Runs of whitespace, underscores, slashes and hyphens collapse to a single hyphen, with none left at either end.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "collapses repeated separators" passes

clauses.text: Empty, whitespace-only, null and undefined input all return an empty string - never undefined, and never a thrown error.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "handles empty input" passes
clauses.rationale: The result goes straight into a URL. "undefined" appearing in a path is a bug that surfaces far from its cause.

clauses.text: Accented and non-Latin characters are transliterated or dropped, leaving only [a-z0-9-].
clauses.observable_by: a test named "strips unicode punctuation" passes

cases.description: the normal path - two words become one hyphenated slug
mixed and repeated separators, plus leading and trailing ones
empty string, whitespace only, null and undefined - the case that ships broken most often
accents, CJK characters, em dashes and quotes - hostile input for anything doing naive string work
